en-US.description: Upload style, fabric, or detail references, enter brand and garment parameters, and generate on-brand fashion design proposals.
en-US.empty.brandName: Please enter a brand name first
en-US.empty.garmentCategory: Please enter a garment category first
en-US.empty.styleImages: Upload at least 1 style reference image first
en-US.error.noModels: No AI model is currently available
en-US.error.noSize: The current model does not provide a usable size preset
en-US.error.referenceLimit: The reference image limit for the current model has been reached
en-US.error.references: The uploaded images do not contain usable reference identifiers
en-US.label: Luxury Brand Design
en-US.modelTryon.help: When enabled, the result includes models wearing the design in the display scene.
en-US.placeholder.designDescription: For example: same-color mixed-material paneling, creative details and craftsmanship
en-US.placeholder.garmentCategory: For example: coat, down jacket, pants
en-US.upload.styleImages.help: Upload style references, fabric swatches, or partial detail images. AI will synthesize them into a cohesive brand-aligned design proposal.

zh-CN.description: 上传参考款式图、面料图或款式局部图，输入品牌与品类等关键参数，生成高度契合品牌调性、指向精准的款式方案。
zh-CN.empty.styleImages: 请先上传至少 1 张款式参考图
zh-CN.error.noModels: 暂无可用 AI 模型
zh-CN.error.noSize: 当前模型缺少可用尺寸配置
zh-CN.error.referenceLimit: 参考图数量已达当前模型上限
zh-CN.error.references: 图片缺少可用于生成的资源标识
zh-CN.label: 大牌设计
zh-CN.modelTryon.help: 开启后，成片将包含模特在陈列场景中试穿展示设计方案。
zh-CN.placeholder.designDescription: 请输入，例如：同色异质拼接设计、有创意的细节和工艺设计
zh-CN.placeholder.displayScene: 请输入，例如：摄影棚、极简、荒漠
zh-CN.placeholder.garmentCategory: 请输入，例如：外套、羽绒服、裤子
zh-CN.placeholder.styleKeywords: 请输入，例如：极简风、学院风、淑女风
zh-CN.toast.success: 大牌设计方案生成成功！
zh-CN.upload.styleImages.help: 支持上传参考款式图、面料图或款式局部图，AI 将综合参考生成契合品牌调性的款式方案。
